title: Crash on Godot 4.5.2 Stable (Windows 11)
body:
### Tested versions

Crash in 4.5.2 Stable

### System information

Windows 11

### Issue description

Installing the plugin into a completely new “4.5.2 stable” (windows 11) project – crash. And it keeps crashing until the folder in /addons is removed.
